problem_context.problem_statement: Verify xizi_single_link_append with a sentinel-head abstraction consistent with LOS list specifications.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Traverse from the sentinel head to the last node, link a disjoint new node, set its next to NULL, and append it to the data-chain.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Require xizi_sll_head(linklist,l) and separate writable ownership of linklist_node->node_next; ensure xizi_sll_head(linklist, app(l, cons(linklist_node,nil))). The l=nil case must represent a head whose next is NULL.
spec_hint: Use xizi_sll_head for the public list abstraction; use xizi_sll/xizi_sllseg only internally for traversal decomposition if needed.
preferred_hidden_properties: Decompose the data-chain into a traversed prefix, current node, and remaining suffix while preserving the sentinel head field and disjoint ownership of the new node.
forbidden_patterns: Do not include the sentinel head address in logical list l.
Do not mirror the C traversal as a new Rocq algorithm.
reference_case_hints: /home/yangfp/OSV/LOS_Verify-capability/annotated_C/src/los_list_h_1.c: LOS_ListTailInsert uses store_dll(head,l) and appends to l, where l excludes the sentinel.
